descriptionChirho: The cardinal number one thousand or a group of one thousand, used as a numerical unit for counting large groups; especially in Revelation for the 144,000 sealed (Rev 7:4-8, 14:1, 14:3), the thousand-year reign (Rev 20:2-7), armies of thousands (Rev 5:11 'thousands of thousands'), and various enumerations of multitudes (Luke 14:31, Acts 4:4, 1 Cor 10:8, Jude 1:14). Singular, plural, and genitive forms are purely inflectional. Spanish 'mil/miles/millares', Arabic 'ألف/آلَاف', Korean '천(들)', Swahili 'elfu/maelfu', Hindi 'हज़ार/हज़ारों'.
